fusions.name: Riverbank Swipe
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. A heavy swipe that deals 20 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound and [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Upstream Crash
fusions.desc: Crashes down on every enemy within 3 tiles for 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Winter Weight
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs 24 damage for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 8%. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fat of the Run
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
